victoryMessage: The kingdom of Munster now dominates all of Ireland. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: The Rock of Cashel, capital of Munster, has recently been captured by Brian Boru, perhaps the most talented young warlord in Irish history. Not all of Munster recognizes him yet as their king, but that will soon change.

victoryMessage: The kingdom of Leinster now dominates all of Ireland. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: The kingdom of Leinster's extensive contact with the Vikings has brought it great wealth through trade. Wielded wisely, this advantage could be used to gain the High Kingship and absolute dominion over all of Ireland.

victoryMessage: The kingdom of Connacht now dominates all of Ireland. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: Descended from the great Conn of the Hundred Battles, the people of Connacht preserve the old ways, isolated and free of foreign influence. Who else could be better suited for driving the Vikings out of Ireland?

victoryMessage: The kingdom of Ulster now dominates all of Ireland. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: The kingdom of Ulster is the traditional heart of power in Ireland, with the ruling Ui Neill dynasty considering itself the rightful heir to the ancient High Kingship of Tara. Without doubt, they will soon have to defend this claim.

victoryMessage: The Vikings now dominate all of Ireland. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: Over the past century, Vikings in Ireland have turned from mere raiders into city-builders, traders and mercenaries. While they possess great warriors and wealthy cities, it will take a great king to lay claim to all Ireland.
